item.title: Pretty setting! Seven acres in North Carolina. Has outbuildings! $399,900
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! Love the pond and there are outbuildings! The house was built in 1939. It is located on seven acres in Sparta, North Carolina. The house features a large covered porch, wood floors, knotty pine, exposed brick and baseboards. The pictures aren’t the greatest. The property has a koi pond, dock, stream, a large barn and other outbuildings. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,980 square feet. $399,900 Contact Darlene Wyatt with Mountain Dreams Realty: 336-372-1622

item.description: Take a look at that library! That is pretty amazing! I remember this house because of that library! Looks like the seller updated bathrooms, kitchen, electrical and HVAC. item.title: Loads of potential! C. 1914. One acre in North Carolina. $179,900
item.description: This house has loads of potential! It just had another price reduction! The house was built in 1914. It is located on 1.06 acres in Bethel, North Carolina. There is a detached garage on the property. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,500 square feet. $179,900 Contact Kevin Lee with Lee and Harrell Real Estate Professionals: 252

item.title: Deal of the Day! Over 5,000 sf in Pennsylvania. Has a guest apartment! $199,000
item.description: This deal of the day is a big house! There is a guest apartment over the garage! The house was built in 1910. It is located on .61 acre in Johnstown, Pennsylvania. The house features pretty stonework, front porch, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, built-in seating, large fireplaces, chair rails, wainscoting, leaded glass and an updated kitchen. There is a detached carriage house with a guest apartment above. Six bedrooms, five bathrooms and 5,116 square feet. $199,000 Contact Renee Lizamb
